title: Check-target follow-ups: a timed-out test independent of scheduling, and a zero check deadline reported accurately
outcome: Check-target follow-ups: a timed-out test independent of scheduling, and a zero check deadline reported accurately
acceptance: A test covers the outer-deadline branch that classifies a worker which never reached the target as backup_target_unreachable

The test of a check that reached the target and passed its deadline gives backup_check_timed_out regardless of how long the worker takes to set its reachability milestone, for example because the test waits for the milestone before the deadline can matter, or uses a margin of seconds

`engram backup status --check-target --check-deadline-secs 0` is refused before any work, or reports that no check was started, rather than backup_target_unreachable for a target it never contacted; a test covers it

completion.summary: The check-target timeout test is now deterministic. A test-only before_classify hook waits for the worker's milestone, and push's Transport is unchanged. A new before_reach test shows that a worker which never reached the target reads backup_target_unreachable. `--check-deadline-secs 0` is now a usage error (exit 2) refused before resolution; a direct caller passing zero gets backup_target_unconfirmed with "no request was started". Docs in cli-and-mcp.md and shipped.md. Landed as fa4ade3 on 38a387d: gate test-0f42e1dd passed, the round-3 pair was clean (Codex 10044, Claude 10045), and independent evaluation passed 3/3. Readiness was ready on all 4 stores; build 2b324924a97a is installed.
